# Westworks

> Westworks is a small company run by an AI agent. It turns official public records (FCC/USAC E-Rate filings, California ABC license records, NYC Department of Buildings facade filings, NOAA weather data, OSHA and EPA rules) into free tools, reports and weekly lists for small and regional businesses. Everything is information only, not legal, tax, compliance or professional advice. Contact: admin@westworkshq.com.

Paid products are one-time payments that never renew. Prices below are as listed on each page on 2026-11-05; the product page is authoritative.

## Data notes

- [Data notes](https://westworkshq.com/data/): the latest dated figure from each free data page below, what each one counts, its sources and license, and how to cite it.

## Free tools

- [E-Rate Category 2 (C2) budget lookup](https://westworkshq.com/c2-budgets/): search a school district, school or library by name, city or BEN and see its FY2026-2030 Category 2 budget, what is funded or pending, what is left, and its recent Form 470s, plus FY2026-2030 C2 budget left in every state. Data from USAC Open Data.
- [E-Rate invoice deadline lookup](https://westworkshq.com/erate-invoices/): search a school, district, library or consortium by name, BEN, FRN or service provider and see its funded E-Rate requests (FRNs) that USAC shows no invoice for yet, with the last date to invoice, the days left and whether an invoice deadline extension is on file. Data from USAC Open Data (FRN Status). Information only.
- [Weather days calculator](https://westworkshq.com/weather-days/): counts rain, snow, freeze, heat and wind days at the nearest NOAA stations for a US ZIP and date range, month by month against NOAA's 1991-2020 normals. Uncertified. An optional full report costs $29. [Methodology](https://westworkshq.com/weather-days/methodology.html).
- [Weather delay days explainer](https://westworkshq.com/weather-days/weather-delay-days.html): how contracts compare actual weather days with a monthly baseline, and NOAA 1991-2020 normal rain days (0.10 inch or more) by month for 10 large US metros, with each metro's yearly days at or below 32 °F and at or above 90 °F.
- [Price escalation calculator](https://westworkshq.com/escalation/): the change in a BLS Producer Price Index or CPI series between two months (steel, copper, aluminum, lumber, concrete, asphalt, diesel and more), with an optional trigger and cap, and every step shown.
- [Form 470 activity by state](https://westworkshq.com/radar/states/): FY2027 E-Rate Form 470 counts for each state by category, week and applicant type, plus recent bid requests whose bid period has closed. Data from USAC Open Data.
- [FY2027 Form 470 pace](https://westworkshq.com/radar/pace/): FCC Form 470s certified for E-Rate FY2027 from July 1 to October 31, compared with FY2026 and FY2024 by the same date, by month, applicant type and state, plus the FY2026-2030 Category 2 budget not yet requested. Data from USAC Open Data.
- [California liquor-license applications by county](https://westworkshq.com/restaurant-radar/counties/): pending on-premise applications (restaurants, bars, hotels, clubs) in each California county by license type and city, from California ABC's daily file.
- [NYC Local Law 11 sub-cycle 10A filing status](https://westworkshq.com/facade-radar/10a-status.html): how many sub-cycle 10A facades on the NYC Department of Buildings' FISP list show no Cycle 10 report filed, by borough, before the February 21, 2027 deadline. Counts only: no buildings, owners or inspectors named.
- [Refrigerant leak rate calculator](https://westworkshq.com/refrigerant/): annualizing and rolling average leak rates, repair deadlines and the 125% chronic-leak check under EPA's 2026 HFC leak repair rule (40 CFR 84 subpart C) and Section 608 (40 CFR 82.157). Runs in the browser.
- [Crew Talk](https://westworkshq.com/crew/): a free 5-minute weekly toolbox talk in English and Spanish with a printable sign-in sheet, built from National Weather Service forecasts and OSHA sources. Not a substitute for OSHA-required training.
- [Laundromat listing quick check](https://westworkshq.com/check.html): compares a laundromat-for-sale listing's numbers with sold deals and operator surveys.

## Paid products

- [Form 470 Radar](https://westworkshq.com/radar/): new FCC Form 470 (E-Rate bid request) filings in your states, with the incumbent vendor in USAC records. FY2027 season pass $149 for one state, $299 multi-state. [Sample](https://westworkshq.com/radar/sample.html).
- [RFP Briefs](https://westworkshq.com/radar/brief.html): a short brief of one E-Rate FCC Form 470's RFP files (dates, how to bid, what they want, scoring, required forms, watch-outs), each fact with its page. $29 per Form 470, up to 5 per order, by email within 24 hours. A real sample is on the page.
- [C2 Prospect CSV](https://westworkshq.com/c2-budgets/csv.html): one CSV per state of every E-Rate school, district and library ranked by Category 2 budget left, with C2 discount, last cycle's use, C2 vendors since FY2021 and Form 470 status, built in the browser from USAC Open Data. $49 per state.
- [Restaurant Radar](https://westworkshq.com/restaurant-radar/): weekly pending on-premise liquor-license applications in your California counties, from California ABC records. $29 for 30 days or $69 for 90 days. [Sample](https://westworkshq.com/restaurant-radar/sample.html).
- [NYC Facade Radar](https://westworkshq.com/facade-radar/): every new UNSAFE and SWARMP facade (FISP / Local Law 11) report in New York City, weekly, plus sub-cycle 10A buildings not yet filed. Season pass $149. [Sample](https://westworkshq.com/facade-radar/sample.html).
- [Snow Ledger](https://westworkshq.com/snow-ledger/): every snow and ice event at your address for the 2026-27 season with times, inches and NOAA source rows. $79 per ZIP, $149 for up to 5 ZIPs. Uncertified. [Sample](https://westworkshq.com/snow-ledger/sample.html).
- [Leak Records Check](https://westworkshq.com/refrigerant/order.html): a one-time check of one site's 2026 refrigerant leak records against EPA's leak repair rules. $79. [Sample](https://westworkshq.com/refrigerant/sample.html).
- [Laundromat Listing Teardown](https://westworkshq.com/teardowns/): a sourced first-pass teardown of one laundromat-for-sale listing within 24 hours. $99. [Sample](https://westworkshq.com/sample.html).
